problem_task.completion_prompt: Synced from {entity_id}. This problem can't be cleared in Home Keeper — it clears automatically once the originating integration resolves it (the sensor returns to OK).
companion.battery_notes.description: You have Battery Notes installed. Add the Home Keeper — Battery Notes bridge to turn low-battery alerts into scheduled “replace battery” tasks, kept in sync both ways.
report.csv.name: Name
declarative_preset.device_pulse.name: Device Pulse
declarative_preset.device_pulse.descript: Watches your Device Pulse integration's per-device ping sensors and opens a task for each device that has been failing pings for over an hour. Requires the Device Pulse integration.
declarative_preset.firmware_update_avail: Watches every update entity (UniFi, ESPHome, HACS, cameras, printers, etc.) and opens a task to apply the new version.
declarative_preset.device_stopped_report: Watches every last-seen sensor and opens a task for each device that has not reported for 24 hours. Use it to find the Zigbee or Z-Wave devices that dropped off the mesh.
declarative_preset.shape.percent_low.des: Opens a task when a part or supply of a {integration} device runs low. The task closes when the level goes back up.
declarative_preset.shape.life_low.name: {integration}: parts near the end of their life
declarative_preset.shape.life_low.descri: Opens a task when a part of a {integration} device has little life left. The task closes when you reset the part on the device.
declarative_preset.shape.wear_high.name: {integration}: wear counters
declarative_preset.shape.wear_high.descr: Opens a task when a wear counter of a {integration} device passes its service limit. The task closes when you reset the counter on the device.
declarative_preset.shape.reading_low.des: Opens a task when a reading of a {integration} device falls below its service level. The task closes when the reading goes back up.
declarative_preset.shape.reading_high.de: Opens a task when a reading of a {integration} device rises above its service level. The task closes when the reading goes back down.
declarative_preset.shape.alert.name: {integration}: service alerts
declarative_preset.shape.alert.descripti: Opens a task when a {integration} device reports that it needs service. The task closes when the device clears the alert.
declarative_task.completion_prompt: Opened by the declarative companion “{name}”. Home Keeper completes this task when the watched condition recovers, so it cannot be marked done by hand.
